failure_modes.description: Assumes riblet structure survives pigging operations without damage
failure_modes.evidence: Pigging operations involve mechanical scrapers moving at high pressure that would likely abrade or destroy delicate riblet structures

failure_modes.description: Claims both drag reduction and increase from same structure
failure_modes.evidence: Riblets have been extensively studied and only show drag reduction when aligned, never both reduction and increase from same configuration

failure_modes.description: Assumes predictable flow separation in straight pipes
failure_modes.evidence: Flow separation in pipes is influenced by numerous factors including surface roughness, Reynolds number, and inlet conditions that make prediction unreliable

failure_modes.description: Falsifier condition already met by hypothesis itself
failure_modes.evidence: Hypothesis predicts contradictory outcomes (drag reduction and increase) which cannot both be true simultaneously

failure_modes.description: Novelty claim invalid as bidirectional drag effects are well-documented
failure_modes.evidence: Multiple studies already demonstrate riblets increase drag when flow is not aligned, contradicting novelty claim
